description: This test module contains integration tests for the approval and publish functionalities of a FastAPI application, focusing on authorization, auditing, and correct API responses.

methods.name: test_approval_sod_violation_returns_403_and_audits_failure(client, audit_repo, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests that an approval decision denied due to SOD violation returns a 403 and logs an audit failure.

methods.name: test_approval_requires_reauth_returns_403_and_audits_failure( client, audit_repo, approval_auth_headers )
methods.description: Tests that approval denial due to missing reauthentication returns a 403 and logs an audit failure.

methods.name: test_publish_requires_approval_returns_403_and_audits_failure( client, audit_repo, auth_headers, idempotency_key )
methods.description: Tests that attempting to publish without approval returns a 403 and logs an audit failure.

methods.name: test_publish_happy_path_returns_200_and_audits_success( client, audit_repo, auth_headers, idempotency_key )
methods.description: Tests the successful publishing flow returns a 200 response with correct data and logs an audit success.
